Scope of Supply

The bidder shall supply one complete High Performance Thin Layer Chromatography (HPTLC) System, inclu ding all essential modules, accessories, software, licences and components required for its proper operatio n, strictly as per the approved technical specifications. 2. Eligibility of Bidder The bidder shall be an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or an authorised dealer/distributor of the O EM. Authorised dealers/distributors shall submit a valid authorisation issued by the OEM for the quoted eq uipment. 3. Point-wise compliance statement against each technical specification prescribed in the bid. c. OEM authorisation certificate, wherever applicable. d. Failure to submit mandatory documents or non-compliance with essential technical specifications may res ult in rejection of the bid, subject to the applicable bid conditions. 4. Delivery, Installation and Commissioning The successful bidder shall deliver, install, test and commission the complete system at the consignee loca tion specified in the GeM contract, within the stipulated delivery period. All expenses relating to transportation, installation, testing and commissioning shall be included in the quo ted price unless otherwise specified in the bid. 5. Demonstration and Training The supplier shall provide onsite demonstration and hands-on operational training to the designated scient ific and technical personnel of the Institute, without additional charges. 6. Warranty The supplier shall provide comprehensive warranty covering parts, labour and service for the warranty per iod specified in the GeM bid, commencing from successful installation, commissioning and acceptance of t he equipment. During the warranty period, defects attributable to manufacturing, components or workmanship shall be r ectified without additional cost to the purchaser, in accordance with the contract conditions. 7. After-Sales Service The bidder shall provide adequate after-sales service and technical support for the supplied equipment. D etails of the service arrangements and contact information shall be furnished with the bid. 8. Make in India The bidder shall comply with the applicable provisions of the Public Procurement (Preference to Make in In dia) Order, 2017, as amended from time to time, including applicable local-content requirements and supp lier classification. Required declarations and supporting documents shall be submitted as prescribed under the bid and applicable orders.

9. Inspection and Acceptance The equipment shall be inspected and tested after delivery and installation. Final acceptance shall be subj ect to satisfactory commissioning and conformity with the approved technical specifications and contractu al requirements. 12. Payment Payment shall be processed in accordance with the applicable GeM contract terms after fulfilment of the pr escribed delivery, installation, commissioning, acceptance and documentation requirements. 13. General Conditions a. All terms and conditions of the GeM bid and contract shall remain applicable. b.
